description: This file contains definitions for multiple Orleans grains demonstrating method interception, call filtering, custom exceptions, attribute usage, and grain observers for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: OutgoingMethodInterceptionGrain
classes.description: Implements a grain that calls other grains to demonstrate method interception.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrain
classes.description: Implements grain call filtering, method interception, and demonstrates handling custom attributes and exceptions.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrain.MyDomainSpecificException
classes.description: A custom domain-specific exception class with serialization support.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrain.MessWithResultAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute used to mark methods for result manipulation.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrainObserver
classes.description: Observer counterpart of MethodInterceptionGrain, supporting similar interception and filtering.

classes.name: GenericMethodInterceptionGrain<T>
classes.description: Generic grain demonstrating method interception based on input argument.

classes.name: TrickyInterceptionGrain
classes.description: Grain with methods having multiple overloads and interception logic based on method names.

classes.name: GenericMethodInterceptionGrainObserver<T>
classes.description: Observer for generic grain with method interception logic.

classes.name: TrickyInterceptionGrainObserver
classes.description: Observer for TrickyInterceptionGrain with method interception logic.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterTestGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing call filtering with retries and request context handling.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterTestGrainObserver
classes.description: Observer with similar call filtering logic as GrainCallFilterTestGrain.

classes.name: CaterpillarGrain
classes.description: Shows method invocation filtering based on context and custom method tags.

methods.name: EchoViaOtherGrain
methods.description: Calls another grain's Echo method asynchronously, returning a dictionary with the result.

methods.name: ThrowIfGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Checks if a value is greater than zero and throws exception if so.

methods.name: One
methods.description: Method that throws InvalidOperationException to simulate restricted invocation.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Returns the input string; marked with custom attribute.

methods.name: NotIntercepted
methods.description: Simple method returning a static string.

methods.name: SayHello
methods.description: Returns greeting string; shared across multiple grains.

methods.name: FilterThrows
methods.description: Method that throws a custom exception, used to test filtering.

methods.name: IncorrectResultType
methods.description: Method designed to return a string but forcibly sets a Guid, testing error handling.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Implementation of IIncomingGrainCallFilter.Invoke, demonstrating various interception scenarios.

methods.name: MyDomainSpecificException
methods.description: Custom exception class with serialization support.

methods.name: MessWithResultAttribute
methods.description: Attribute used to mark methods for special result manipulation.

methods.name: GetInputAsString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the input parameter.

methods.name: GetBestNumber
methods.description: Returns a fixed number, used in intercepted methods.

methods.name: Eat
methods.description: Method with custom attribute tag; overloads for different parameter types.

methods.name: EatWith
methods.description: Method with multiple parameters and custom attribute tags.

methods.name: SumSet
methods.description: Computes the sum of a set of integers.
